control_model_microsecond_aggregated.interpretation: Microsecond aggregation compresses 5000 raw fills into 646 unique timestamp matching events (-87.1%). Aggregated spectral radius drops to 0.5667 (SUBCRITICAL_STABLE). This empirical comparison demonstrates that measured point-process self-excitation is highly sensitive to the definition of the event unit (individual child execution vs. matching engine time slice), rather than establishing definitive causal attribution of trader behavior.
